rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded high-grade blastocyst with reassuring ICM and cohesive TE, broadly consistent with the provided 3AA grade; minor overreach in calling it 3–4AA and commenting on zona thinning from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, AMH, endometriosis, prior IVF failure, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and day-5 status with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate caveats about morphology and untested embryos; probability estimate is plausible though somewhat broad and slightly optimistic.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with common IVF practice, including SET and avoiding unsupported add-ons; a few suggestions about protocol changes/endometriosis suppression are more individualized than guideline-driven.

Provides clear practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including SET, luteal support adherence, review of endometriosis management, uterine evaluation if repeated failure, and embryo banking discussion.
